children: Ukraine's consumer price inflation accelerated to 8.1% year-on-year in August from 7.7% in July, the statistics service said on Wednesday.

Inflation is rising faster than forecast after Russia intensified air attacks on Ukrainian logistics and infrastructure. The central bank has said rising business costs and logistics disruptions will add 0.4 to 0.6 percentage points to the inflation rate this year, and has forecast consumer inflation of about 10% at the end of 2026.
